|lore=Frequently engaged in brawls at the local enlisted clubs on homeworld of Corulag. Stormtrooper assigned to biker scout unit. Monitors Yuzzum activity.
|game_text=Adds 3 to power of any speeder bike he pilots. While piloting a speeder bike, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Once per game, may take a speeder bike (or an Effect with 'speeder bike' in game text) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
